scope: Two crates since 2026-11-11: `ravum-lang-sema` (frontend) and `ravum-lang-codegen` (the reference backend, which generates the safe Rust). Before that date only sema was measured, so the backend that actually emits code had no coverage gate at all. Including both crates in one instrumented build also means the sema figures now count the sema code exercised by the codegen integration tests.
policy: Ratchet. A floor never goes down: lowering one requires changing this file in the same commit with a justification, and the reviewer must ask why the code that used to be covered no longer is. Floors sit one point below the measurement of the commit that introduced them so a compiler or llvm-cov upgrade cannot flip the gate on rounding noise; the real target is the gate target below, not the floor.

objective.note: Objectif ratifié par le responsable : 100 % de couverture de lignes ET de régions sur chaque fichier mesuré. Les seuils `files` restent le cliquet qui garde la CI verte aujourd'hui ; ils sont relevés à chaque passe, et `python tools/coverage_report.py --input ... --gap` liste, fichier par fichier, les lignes non couvertes qui restent à traiter. Aucune exclusion permanente : le code mort est supprimé, pas exclu, et un fichier à 100 % doit l'être par des tests.

gate_targets.note: Core 1.0 coverage objective (docs/roadmap/CORE-1.0-GATE-MATRIX.md T10). Not met yet on these two files: the floors below are the current proven level, and they are raised whenever a pass raises the measurement. The codegen files are new floors (2026-11-11): their target is also 90/85, and `emit.rs` carries the most risk because it is the code that decides what the generated Rust looks like.

crates/ravum-lang-sema/src/effects.rs.note: 2026-11-13 (batch 1): raised from 91/93 to 92/94 (measurement 93.29/95.02). The 22 remaining uncovered lines are line 65/81 (fixpoint and signature write-back), 193 (impl fn collection), 252/326/329/372/388/403/405 (defensive match arms) and 128-141 (the `test_fns` entry branch, structurally unreachable while `#[test]` is refused with E-UNSUPPORTED-ATTR).

crates/ravum-lang-sema/src/builtins.rs.note: 2026-11-13 (batch 1): raised from 90/88 to 100/98. Line coverage is complete: `type_from_str` now has tests for every compound form it accepts and for the malformed text it must refuse. The region gap is the `?` recovery edges of that parser; the region floor stays one point under the measurement.

crates/ravum-lang-sema/src/own.rs.note: 2026-11-11: raised from 89/86 to 91/89 (measurement 92.11/90.14 with the codegen integration tests included). 2026-11-13: re-measured 92.43/90.17; floor unchanged.

crates/ravum-lang-sema/src/check.rs.note: Thinnest margin of the file set: 0.26 point above the line floor. It is the file to attack first when raising the sema floors.

crates/ravum-lang-sema/src/facts.rs.note: 2026-11-13 (batch 1): raised from 81/76 to 100/100. The file reached 100 % lines and regions after three dead helpers were deleted (`expr_type`, `EffectSet::pure`, `EffectSet::is_subset_of`) and the contracts were tested: effect name round trip, effect set display/union/difference, profile parse/name/forbidden, `FileInfo::line_of`, `file_infos`. The floor is now the objective, so a regression fails the gate.

Gate target 90/85 met.

crates/ravum-lang-sema/src/resolve.rs.note: 2026-11-10: 67.44/67.98 -> 93.03/93.50 with resolve_contracts.rs (112 tests). 2026-11-13 (batch 1): raised from 92/92 to 93/93 after the unused `World::module` accessor was deleted. Gate target 90/85 met.

crates/ravum-lang-codegen/src/emit.rs.note: New floor 2026-11-11: the backend was never measured before, although it is the code that decides what the generated Rust looks like. Target 90/85. 2026-11-13: re-measured 87.00/86.02 into the 2026-11-13 profile; floor unchanged.

Raised to 100/100 on 2026-11-14 (round 9): the only uncovered code was `CodegenError`'s `Display::fmt`, now exercised by `tests::codegen_error_displays_its_message`; `cargo llvm-cov` measures 100 % lines and regions on this file.
